SpectralRound11B.genuineMellinJet_normalization.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (chi : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (z : ℂ) (a s alpha : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  genuineNormalizedMellinJet K chi z a s alpha m x * ↑(nativeHalfWeight alpha s (classLog K x)) =
    genuineMellinJet K chi z a m x

SpectralRound11B.native_normalization_memLp_iff.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (alpha s : ℝ) (f : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f mu) :
  MemLp (fun x => ↑(nativeHalfWeight alpha s (classLog K x)) * f x) 2 mu ↔
    Integrable (fun x => Round175B.nativeWeight alpha s (classLog K x) * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) mu

SpectralRound11B.native_pairing_formula.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (chi : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K)
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (z : ℂ) (a s alpha : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
  (hg : MemLp (genuineNormalizedMellinJet K chi z a s alpha m) 2 mu) (f : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hF : MemLp (fun x => ↑(nativeHalfWeight alpha s (classLog K x)) * f x) 2 mu) :
  (normalizedBilinearFunctional mu (genuineNormalizedMellinJet K chi z a s alpha m) hg)
      (MemLp.toLp (fun x => ↑(nativeHalfWeight alpha s (classLog K x)) * f x) hF) =
    ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), genuineMellinJet K chi z a m x * f x ∂mu

SpectralRound12B.native_normalization_surjective.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (alpha s : ℝ) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  ∃ f,
    AEStronglyMeasurable f mu ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Round175B.nativeWeight alpha s (classLog K x) * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) mu ∧
        ∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ↑(nativeHalfWeight alpha s (classLog K x)) * f x = ↑↑F x

SpectralRound12B.native_pairing_integrable.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (chi : UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (z : ℂ) (a s alpha : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
  (hg : MemLp (genuineNormalizedMellinJet K chi z a s alpha m) 2 mu) (f : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
